title: console(form): a lookup with dependsOn keeps its value when the parent changes — an invoice saves a contact from a different account
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21784 · records-forms.cascading-multilevel-and-clear · acceptance[3]

A clause of `records-forms.cascading-multilevel-and-clear` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21784 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF3, RUNNER rule 7) confirmed it: P2 (confirmed by code; runner reproduced live twice). It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui.

## Reproduction

1. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_invoice` → New.
2. Account → Northwind; Contact → "Prospect 18" (a Northwind contact). Candidate request `GET /data/showcase_contact?filter=["account","=",{NW}]` → 26 rows (correct).
3. Switch Account to Contoso (pick directly, or remove the chip then pick).
4. Status → Draft; Create.
5. Expected: the contact clears on the account change. Actual: the chip stays; `GET` of the new invoice reads `account:{Contoso id}`, `contact:{the Northwind contact}`. With the account removed the field still shows "Prospect 18 · Select Account first".

## Mechanism

- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx:1982-2045` — the only cascade-clear effect skips every field whose type is not in `CASCADE_OPTION_WIDGET_TYPES` (`:2004`, no `lookup` member; `app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts:200` says so) and requires static `options` (`:2005-2006`).
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx:640-654` only re-scopes the candidate query from `dependentValues`; its sole `onChange(null)` is the manual remove (`:1012`).
- Fixture: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts:96` contact `dependsOn: ['account']`. The server reference gate checks existence only, so the client clear is the only guard. Predates 17.6.0 by code.

## Done when

Changing (or clearing) a lookup's `dependsOn` parent clears a selection that no longer satisfies the dependent filter.
